Rae (Finance): Quick follow-up from the vendor call — they offered a blended commit + seat model and mentioned a $7.5k pilot credit. Need a mock invoice showing how the credit applies before/after amortization.
Ben (Procurement): I'll take this. Also need termination refund language and whether commits can be monthly amortized.
Sam (VendorRep): Hey all — pilot credit applies before amortization. Commits can be billed upfront or amortized monthly. Termination: pro-rata refund if >60 days notice, admin fee applies.
Ivy (Eng): Two asks: 1) can we get daily usage CSV (per-route tokens)? 2) is per-route SLA possible so only chat has p95 guarantees?
Sam (VendorRep): We can provide daily CSV with per-route token counts and latencies. Per-route SLA supported as an add-on.
po-bot: PO draft PR-5599 created and assigned to Ben.
Rae (Finance): Action items: vendor to share mock invoice + CSV; procurement to draft PO; legal to get SLA wording. Target: artifacts by Tue EOD.
Ben (Procurement): Noted — will coordinate and schedule a 30m walkthrough with vendor.
Sam (VendorRep): Will upload artifacts and sample invoice by Tue EOD.
